value.body: An accountant records a business's transactions, prepares its financial statements, and handles GST, TDS and income-tax filings. Employers include companies of every size, CA firms and accounting outsourcing centres. A typical day involves entering and checking entries, reconciling bank accounts, and preparing returns before monthly and quarterly deadlines.

items.label: Typical entry
items.note: CA, CMA or CS study often runs alongside the job

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Tally, Excel, GST portal, income-tax portal

items.label: Key deadlines
items.value: Monthly GST and TDS; quarterly and annual returns

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Most freshers join as an accounts executive or junior accountant in a small or mid-size firm or a CA practice, often after a short practical course in Tally and GST. Articleship during the CA course is another common way in.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Preparing profit & loss and balance sheet

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior accountant, accounts manager, finance controller.
A professional qualification (CA, CMA) widens options and seniority.
Routine data entry is increasingly automated, so analysis and compliance skills carry more weight.
